    Turn a discrete-event game run into a (group, card) behaviour frame

    Source: R/fidelity.R
    sdt_run_behaviour.Rd

    Reshapes the event log of a sdt_simulate() run into the same one-row-per (group, card) frame that sdt_fidelity() scores, so the discrete-event engine can be held to exactly the same statistics as a fitted behaviour model. Each replication is one group and each casualty id is one card, which is what makes the comparison legitimate: groups within a real course session play the same fixed deck, and so do replications.

    Usage

    sdt_run_behaviour(run, group = "group_id", card = "card")

    Arguments

    run

    A game_run from sdt_simulate().

    group

    Name for the group column in the result.

    card

    Name for the card column in the result.

    Value

    A tibble with one row per (replication, casualty), the two key columns named by group and card, the cohort's triage and therapy, the casualty's end_area, and one logical column per behaviour described above.

    What each column means, and what it cannot mean

    • red, yellow, green, ETC, DCS, TASC and ventilated are read off the cohort. The engine routes on them, it does not choose them, so they are identical in every replication and their between-group SD is exactly zero. That is not a bug in this function; it is the engine's structure made visible, and sdt_fidelity() will report it as an infinite dispersion ratio.

    • surgery, diagnostics, icu, ward, recovery, green_area record whether the casualty ever entered that board area. These can vary between replications, through queueing and the horizon.

    • died is end_area == "morgue", and not_seen is a casualty the game ended before. The engine has no branch to the morgue, so died is always FALSE.

    The observed counterparts, for a course export, are therapy == "TASC" and so on for the therapy concepts, called_triage == "red" for the sighting categories, therapy != "none" for surgery, and the reported end location for icu. There is deliberately no eFAST or CT column: the engine has a single radiology area and no modality, so inventing one would be inventing a comparison.

    See also

    sdt_fidelity(), summary.game_run().

    Examples

    co <- sdt_synthetic_cohort(n = 12, seed = 1)
run <- sdt_simulate(sdt_scenario(co), replications = 3, seed = 1,
                    verbose = FALSE)
sdt_run_behaviour(run)
#> # A tibble: 36 × 20
#>    group_id card  triage therapy ventilated red   yellow green ETC   DCS   TASC 
#>    <chr>    <chr> <chr>  <chr>   <lgl>      <lgl> <lgl>  <lgl> <lgl> <lgl> <lgl>
#>  1 rep001   P001  red    TASC    TRUE       TRUE  FALSE  FALSE FALSE FALSE TRUE 
#>  2 rep001   P002  red    TASC    TRUE       TRUE  FALSE  FALSE FALSE FALSE TRUE 
#>  3 rep001   P003  green  none    FALSE      FALSE FALSE  TRUE  FALSE FALSE FALSE
#>  4 rep001   P004  yellow TASC    FALSE      FALSE TRUE   FALSE FALSE FALSE TRUE 
#>  5 rep001   P005  red    DCS     FALSE      TRUE  FALSE  FALSE FALSE TRUE  FALSE
#>  6 rep001   P006  yellow TASC    FALSE      FALSE TRUE   FALSE FALSE FALSE TRUE 
#>  7 rep001   P007  yellow TASC    FALSE      FALSE TRUE   FALSE FALSE FALSE TRUE 
#>  8 rep001   P008  green  none    FALSE      FALSE FALSE  TRUE  FALSE FALSE FALSE
#>  9 rep001   P009  green  none    FALSE      FALSE FALSE  TRUE  FALSE FALSE FALSE
#> 10 rep001   P010  red    TASC    FALSE      TRUE  FALSE  FALSE FALSE FALSE TRUE 
#> # ℹ 26 more rows
#> # ℹ 9 more variables: surgery <lgl>, diagnostics <lgl>, icu <lgl>, ward <lgl>,
#> #   recovery <lgl>, green_area <lgl>, end_area <chr>, died <lgl>,
#> #   not_seen <lgl>
